items.title: Travelers (TRV) Stock Looks Cheap On Earnings But Pricey On Past Returns
items.summary: After a strong five year run, Travelers Companies now looks closer to fairly priced, which raises questions for investors who are trying to judge how much of that success is already reflected in the share price. items.title: Travelers (TRV): Buy, Sell, or Hold Post Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: Since August 2021, the S&P 500 has delivered a total return of 70.1%. But one standout stock has nearly doubled the market - over the past five years, Travelers has surged 129% to $371.89 per share. Its momentum hasn’t stopped as it’s also gained 20.5% in the last six months, beating the S&P by 8.8%.
